In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the crew of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' embarked on a '''hunt for Jorj Car'das''', whom they believed possessed a complete copy of the elusive [[Caamas Document]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was in the midst of a [[Caamas Document Crisis|crisis]] regarding the document&mdash;a partial copy had been found that implicated members of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction of Caamas]] [[19 BBY/Legends|thirty-eight years prior]], and anti-Bothan sentiment was strong throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A complete copy would name specific names and vindicate the species as a whole, and the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Talon Karrde]] agreed to track down his former boss, [[Jorj Car'das]], in an effort to stem the crisis.

With Karrde and his crew were the former [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Shada D'ukal]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The vessel traveled deep into the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] and were finally able to locate Car'das with the help of Car'das's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Entoo Needaan E-elz]]. On the fabled [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Exocron]], Karrde was disappointed to find that Car'das was a feeble and senile old man, but he pledged the ''Wild Karrde'' to the [[Battle of Exocron|defense]] of the world when the forces of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rei'Kas]] attacked. The pirate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was wiped out by the mysterious [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks, however, who were aligned with Car'das&mdash;Karrde discovered that his former boss's senility had been a ruse, and Car'das welcomed Karrde, D'ukal, and C-3PO into his [[Jorj Car'das's fortress|fortress]].

Although Car'das did not have a copy of the Caamas Document, he did have a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that would greatly aid the New Republic. Not long before Karrde had set out on the hunt, the long-dead [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had returned to lead the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in a renewed push against the New Republic, but Car'das's datacard revealed that "Thrawn" was in fact a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] named [[Flim (Human)|Flim]]. The Aing-Tii monks used their ability to [[fold space]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and instantaneously transported the ''Wild Karrde'' across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], where Karrde met with the Remnant's Grand Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who himself had been left out of the coup involving Flim and in fact wanted peace with the New Republic.

The [[Sinister Triumvirate]], of which Flim had been a part, was foiled, and a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] that had been taking place at Yaga Minor was averted. Meanwhile, C-3PO's [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had found a complete copy of the Caamas Document on the planet [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]], and the galactic crisis wound down. With the Imperial Remnant firmly back under his control, Pellaeon signed [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace accords]] with the New Republic's [[President/Legends|President]] [[Ponc Gavrisom|Gavrisom]], and the long-running [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was brought to an end.
